entries.name: sigma
entries.meaning: Standard deviation of a distribution; also the GPR posterior standard deviation (uncertainty at a prediction point).

entries.name: mu
entries.meaning: Mean of a distribution; also the GPR posterior mean (the point prediction).

entries.name: epsilon
entries.meaning: Residual or model error: ε = y − ŷ.

entries.name: alpha
entries.meaning: GPR noise regularisation (nugget). Added to the diagonal of the covariance matrix to improve numerical stability and allow noisy observations.

entries.name: rho
entries.meaning: Multi-fidelity scaling factor (Kennedy–O'Hagan). Scales the low-fidelity prediction before adding the correction term.

entries.name: delta
entries.meaning: Multi-fidelity correction term. A GP trained on the residuals between high-fidelity and scaled low-fidelity predictions.

entries.name: nu
entries.meaning: Matérn kernel smoothness parameter. ν = 3/2 → once differentiable; ν = 5/2 → twice differentiable; ν → ∞ → RBF (infinitely smooth).

entries.name: y-hat
entries.meaning: Predicted output value from the surrogate model.

entries.name: y-bar
entries.meaning: Mean of the observed output values in the dataset.

entries.name: y
entries.meaning: True (observed) output value.

entries.name: X (matrix)
entries.meaning: Input matrix. Rows are data points; columns are input variables.

entries.name: x-star
entries.meaning: A new input point where a prediction is requested (not in the training set).

entries.name: R-squared
entries.meaning: Coefficient of determination. Fraction of output variance explained by the model. Range: −∞ to 1; 1 = perfect.

entries.name: S-one
entries.meaning: Sobol first-order sensitivity index. Fraction of output variance due to one input acting independently.

entries.name: S-total
entries.meaning: Sobol total-order sensitivity index. Total contribution including all interaction effects with other inputs.

entries.name: Q1
entries.meaning: First quartile (25th percentile) of a column's distribution.

entries.name: Q3
entries.meaning: Third quartile (75th percentile) of a column's distribution.

entries.name: IQR
entries.meaning: Interquartile range = Q3 − Q1. Measures the spread of the middle 50% of data.

entries.name: k (folds)
entries.meaning: Number of folds in k-fold cross-validation.

entries.name: n
entries.meaning: Number of data points (rows) in the dataset or training set.

entries.name: K (kernel)
entries.meaning: Covariance (kernel) matrix in GPR. Entry K(xᵢ, xⱼ) encodes the similarity between points xᵢ and xⱼ.

entries.name: subscript 1
entries.meaning: First-order (e.g. S₁ = first-order Sobol index).

entries.name: subscript t
entries.meaning: Total-order (e.g. Sₜ = total-order Sobol index).

entries.name: subscript i
entries.meaning: Index of the i-th data point or i-th input variable.

entries.name: superscript 2
entries.meaning: Squared (e.g. R² = R-squared).

entries.name: superscript *
entries.meaning: Optimal value or prediction point (e.g. x* = query point, μ* = posterior mean).

entries.name: hat (circumflex)
entries.meaning: Estimated or predicted quantity (e.g. ŷ = predicted output).

entries.name: bar (macron)
entries.meaning: Mean value (e.g. ȳ = mean of y).

entries.name: subscript train
entries.meaning: Refers to the training subset (e.g. R²_train = training R²).

entries.name: subscript test
entries.meaning: Refers to the held-out test subset (e.g. R²_test = test R²).

entries.name: subscript LF
entries.meaning: Low-fidelity model output (multi-fidelity context).

entries.name: subscript HF
entries.meaning: High-fidelity model output (multi-fidelity context).

entries.name: Gaussian Process Regression
entries.meaning: Probabilistic surrogate that provides both predictions and uncertainty estimates.

entries.name: Random Forest
entries.meaning: Ensemble of decision trees. Robust to non-linear, non-smooth responses.

entries.name: Radial Basis Function
entries.meaning: Interpolating surrogate. Always passes through training points exactly.

entries.name: Polynomial Chaos Expansion
entries.meaning: Polynomial surrogate with free sensitivity indices as a byproduct.

entries.name: Cross-Validation
entries.meaning: Technique to estimate model accuracy on held-out folds of the training set.

entries.name: Latin Hypercube Sampling
entries.meaning: Space-filling design: one sample per equal-width interval per dimension.

entries.name: Expected Improvement
entries.meaning: Active learning acquisition function balancing exploitation and exploration.

entries.name: Mean Absolute Error
entries.meaning: Average absolute prediction error. Robust to outliers; same units as output.

entries.name: Root Mean Squared Error
entries.meaning: Square root of mean squared error. Penalises large errors more than MAE.

entries.name: One-at-a-Time
entries.meaning: Sensitivity method that sweeps one input while holding all others at median.

entries.name: Principal Component Analysis
entries.meaning: Dimensionality reduction projecting correlated inputs into uncorrelated components.

entries.name: Variance Inflation Factor
entries.meaning: Multicollinearity diagnostic. VIF ≥ 10 flags near-redundant inputs.

entries.name: Sum of Squares
entries.meaning: SS_res = sum of squared residuals; SS_tot = total sum of squares (relative to mean).

entries.name: Controlled Unclassified Information
entries.meaning: Data classification level. Restricts handling and sharing of the session.

entries.name: International Traffic in Arms Regulations
entries.meaning: Export control classification. Applies to defence-related technical data.

entries.name: Export Administration Regulations
entries.meaning: Export control classification. Applies to dual-use commercial technology.
